profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Skyward
profile.summary:
My name is Eric Maccoux, and I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer at Skyward, Inc., working on both our brand-new Qmlativ SIS and ERS product and our tool for migrating customer data from Skyward's legacy SIS software to its redesigned version.

I've spent my entire life trying to find new ways to help other people, whether that be creating innovative software applications to make life easier for a targeted audience, working directly with customers to help solve any number of technical issues, turning complex ideas and procedures into simple documentation that anyone can understand, or entertaining them through the power of theatre and music.  I'm always looking to take part in new experiences, and I'm constantly searching for ways to challenge myself. If you'd like to get in touch with me, feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Work on migrating customer data from Skyward's legacy SIS software to its redesigned version
- Create internal utilities for comparing the quality and correctness of recent migrations
- Improve the product's framework for processing state-specific Ed-Fi data
- Design and write various training courses for new hires
- Led small team in crafting module within redesigned SIS software for allowing parents to view their child's health information and nurse visits
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Technical Writing · Teamwork · Programming · Time Management · Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving · Leadership · Team Leadership · Visual Studio · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · GitHub

positions.title: Identity & Access Management Student Intern
positions.description:
- Redesigned the department’s Cherwell support dashboard from the ground up, adding widgets to track the user’s owned incidents, list any of the department’s stale incidents, and assist with case review
- Built a decision tree system for DoIT Help Desk agents to troubleshoot various identity-based services offered at UW-Madison, dramatically decreasing average call times
- Reviewed the department’s internal wiki-based documentation system, identified documents that were inaccurate or irrelevant, and migrated the rest over to the university’s own KnowledgeBase platform for easier editing/viewing
- Utilized HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Cherwell Dashboard Editor, and knowledge in effective technical writing

positions.title: Student Team Lead, Technical Writer
positions.description:
- Managed the Help Desk's response to the coronavirus pandemic and communicated any policy decisions to all agents in a timely and transparent fashion
- Planned out and wrote technical documentation for both DoIT and university use
- Oversaw the DoIT Help Desk's day-to-day operations and created/maintained the weekly schedule for 92 agents
- Assisted UW-Madison students, faculty, staff, and emeriti with various tech-related issues over the phone and via chat/email
- Utilized HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and knowledge in customer service, leadership, and team management

positions.title: Marketing and Social Media Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed the various social media pages of InterMission Theatre
- Designed, developed, and mainained the InterMission Theatre website
- Voted in board meetings on important issues relating to the organization
- Organized social events for the organization (formal events, theatre outings, etc.)
- Performed as actor and singer

positions.title: Trustee
positions.description: Skills: Teamwork · Time Management · Communication · Problem Solving · Singing · Acting

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Independently designed and developed a specialized data input application that read cells from Excel spreadsheets and parsed them into a SQL Server database for later consumption/slicing
- Created intricate dashboards in Microsoft Power BI that integrated with SQL Server databases to display data accurately and easily
- Wrote technical documentation for each application developed, both for the purposes of continuing development in the future as well as assisting users with utilizing the software
- Utilized ASP.NET, C#, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Git, SQL Server, IIS Server, Visual Studio, and Microsoft Power BI
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Technical Writing · Teamwork · Programming · Time Management · Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving · Visual Studio · Microsoft SQL Server · GitHub

positions.title: Technology Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Deployed numerous devices across the district’s 43 schools
- Worked with a team of five people to organize inventory and help with various projects in the district
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Time Management · Communication · Problem Solving
